about: has.motion and has.controls are declared false, but the HTML file holds a button and an animated SVG, and its style block has :focus selectors: FP-CONF-11 fails for both. Separately, a :focus rule removes the outline with no replacement, which is a machine finding under FP-A11Y-12; the :focus-visible rule beside it sets a box-shadow and is not flagged.

findings.message: has.motion is false but the scope contains motion
has.controls is false but the scope contains controls
